sentences.en: on Thursday.
sentences.zh: 星期四。

sentences.en: The story that we are going to be spending the entire conversation focused on is what I think of as really the first major blow-up, blunder,
sentences.zh: 我们整个谈话将集中讨论的故事，我认为是特朗普第二任期内真正的第一次重大爆发、失误，

sentences.en: perhaps even scandal of Trump's second term, which is the signal text messaging security breach, in which Jeffrey Goldberg, who was a guest on the show earlier this week,
sentences.zh: 甚至可能是丑闻，那就是Signal短信安全漏洞。本周早些时候曾做客节目的《大西洋》杂志主编杰弗里·戈德堡，

sentences.en: editor of the Atlantic magazine, became the recipient of this days-long series of text messages in which the most senior officials in the White House
sentences.zh: 收到了这一连串持续数日的短信，其中白宫最高级别的官员们

sentences.en: discussed plans for an attack on Houthi terrorists in Yemen.
sentences.zh: 讨论了针对也门胡塞武装分子的袭击计划。

sentences.en: And what we know through multiple days of disclosures from Jeff Goldberg and the Atlantic is that those texts were very detailed, down to the type of aircraft to be used,
sentences.zh: 通过杰夫·戈德堡和《大西洋》杂志多日的披露，我们了解到这些短信非常详细，甚至精确到了所使用的飞机型号，

sentences.en: precise timing of attacks.
sentences.zh: 以及袭击的精确时间。

sentences.en: And that's really where I want to start.
sentences.zh: 这正是我想开始切入的地方。

sentences.en: Settle for us, if you can.
sentences.zh: 如果可以的话，请为我们理清一下。

sentences.en: Was this information in these texts classified or not?
sentences.zh: 这些短信中的信息是否属于机密？

sentences.en: Eric, what do you say?
sentences.zh: 埃里克，你怎么看？

sentences.en: Well, Pete Hegseth basically says, no, it was not classified.
sentences.zh: 嗯，皮特·海格塞斯基本上说，不，那不是机密。

sentences.en: But we have talked to several senior military officials
sentences.zh: 但我们采访了几位高级军事官员

sentences.en: and pilots who have flown these missions who say it certainly had to have been classified when it was shared.
sentences.zh: 以及执行过这些任务的飞行员，他们表示，在分享这些信息时，它肯定属于机密。

sentences.en: Whether it was declassified, perhaps, after the fact, is possible, but we don't know that.
sentences.zh: 事后是否解密了，这有可能，但我们不知道。

sentences.en: And why do they say it has to be classified?
sentences.zh: 他们为什么说它一定是机密？

sentences.en: Can you just explain that?
sentences.zh: 你能解释一下吗？

sentences.en: It was sent just two hours or so before the first strikes were to take place against the Houthis on March 15th.
sentences.zh: 这些短信是在3月15日对胡塞武装进行首次打击前大约两个小时发出的。

sentences.en: And you don't want this information getting out ahead of any attack because it puts, in this case, U.S.
sentences.zh: 你肯定不希望这些信息在袭击前泄露，因为这会使美国

sentences.en: pilots at risk.
sentences.zh: 飞行员处于危险之中。

sentences.en: And so, almost by definition, officials are telling us this had to be classified at the time.
sentences.zh: 所以，官员们告诉我们，几乎可以肯定这些信息在当时必须是机密的。

sentences.en: Julian, do you concur with that?
sentences.zh: 朱利安，你同意吗？

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对同意。

sentences.en: I mean, there are ways to talk around classified information.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，有很多方法可以绕过机密信息来交谈。

sentences.en: You can be generalized.
sentences.zh: 你可以说得笼统一些。

sentences.en: You can take out specifics.
sentences.zh: 你可以去掉具体细节。

sentences.en: But that's not what happens with the details of the strike.
sentences.zh: 但关于袭击的细节并非如此。

sentences.en: Like, when you say this kind of plane is taking off at this hour, that is highly classified for a reason.
sentences.zh: 比如，当你提到这种飞机在几点起飞时，这是高度机密的，是有原因的。

sentences.en: The reason being is if it fell in enemy hands, it could be actionable.
sentences.zh: 原因在于，如果它落入敌手，可能会被利用。

sentences.en: So, that's why that kind of information, troop movement information,
sentences.zh: 所以，这就是为什么那种信息，即部队调动信息，

sentences.en: prior to it being executed, is always among the most classified information that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 在执行之前，总是属于美国所拥有的

sentences.en: possesses.
sentences.zh: 最高机密信息。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And I just want to give an example of some of the language in the text messages that were sent by Pete Hexeth, the defense secretary.
sentences.zh: 我想举几个国防部长皮特·海格塞斯发送的短信中的例子。

sentences.en: This is a quote.
sentences.zh: 这是一段引用。

sentences.en: More F-18s launch.
sentences.zh: 更多F-18战机起飞。

sentences.en: Parentheses.
sentences.zh: 括号。

sentences.en: Second strike package.
sentences.zh: 第二波打击编队。

sentences.en: So, five minutes later.
sentences.zh: 也就是五分钟后。

sentences.en: Strike drones on target.
sentences.zh: 打击无人机抵达目标。

sentences.en: So, it's really specific.
sentences.zh: 所以，这非常具体。

sentences.en: Maggie, do you have a sense of, given what Eric and Julian just said,
sentences.zh: 玛吉，考虑到埃里克和朱利安刚才所说的，你是否了解

sentences.en: why senior officials from the Trump administration who were on these text chains are so definitively denying that anything in those messages were classified?
sentences.zh: 为什么特朗普政府中参与这些短信链的高级官员如此断然地否认这些信息中包含任何机密内容？

sentences.en: I mean, two of them,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，其中两人，

sentences.en: Director of National Intelligence,
sentences.zh: 国家情报总监，

sentences.en: Tulsi Gabbard, CIA Director John Ratcliffe, happened to be testifying before Congress this week, and of course, they're asked about this,
sentences.zh: 图尔西·加巴德，中央情报局局长约翰·拉特克利夫，本周恰好在国会作证，当然，他们被问及此事，

sentences.en: and repeatedly they say none of this is classified.
sentences.zh: 他们反复表示这些都不是机密。

sentences.en: So, are they applying some kind of a legal definition that perhaps lies outside of what our colleagues are describing?
sentences.zh: 那么，他们是否在应用某种法律定义，而这种定义可能超出了我们同事所描述的范围？

sentences.en: Is this a political explanation?
sentences.zh: 这是一种政治解释吗？

sentences.en: Are they just kind of daring the political system to hold them accountable for what might not be a true statement?
sentences.zh: 他们只是在挑战政治体制，看是否能让他们为可能不属实的话负责？

sentences.en: How do you think about that?
sentences.zh: 你是怎么看待这个问题的？

sentences.en: The answer is yes to all three questions.
sentences.zh: 这三个问题的答案都是肯定的。

sentences.en: Look, I didn't watch all of the hours of testimony that Tulsi Gabbard and John Ratcliffe gave, so I can't speak to the expanse of everything they said,
sentences.zh: 听着，我没有看完图尔西·加巴德和约翰·拉特克利夫作证的所有小时数，所以我无法评价他们所说的一切的广度，

sentences.en: but as I understand it, as I've read, as some of what you've described, they are adhering to this line that it was not classified.
sentences.zh: 但据我所知，据我所读，以及你所描述的部分内容，他们坚持认为这不是机密。

sentences.en: That is extremely hard to fathom.
sentences.zh: 这极其令人费解。

sentences.en: We don't know more than we know, but it's for all the reasons Eric and Julian said, it's hard to believe that.
sentences.zh: 我们知道的还不够多，但基于埃里克和朱利安所说的所有原因，这很难让人相信。

sentences.en: So, I think that this is a line that is coming down from the White House, which is that they are going to insist this was not classified information and try to plow through
sentences.zh: 所以我认为，这是白宫传达下来的一条口径，即他们将坚持认为这不是机密信息，并试图硬撑过去，

sentences.en: and wait for the story to pass and wait for the storm to pass.
sentences.zh: 等待风波平息。

sentences.en: Trump himself seemed to be moving a bit away from that on Wednesday when he said, you know, maybe it was classified, who knows?
sentences.zh: 特朗普本人周三似乎有点动摇，他说，你知道，也许是机密，谁知道呢？

sentences.en: But they have come to see and have leaned into the idea that there is nothing other than the courts that could hold them accountable,
sentences.zh: 但他们已经开始认为，除了法院之外，没有任何东西能让他们负责，

sentences.en: and they clearly are challenging that right now, too.
sentences.zh: 而且他们现在显然也在挑战这一点。

sentences.en: So, they are the law.
sentences.zh: 所以，他们就是法律。

sentences.en: They control the Justice Department.
sentences.zh: 他们控制着司法部。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: They control the FBI.
sentences.zh: 他们控制着联邦调查局。

sentences.en: Well, let's talk a bit more about what you just mentioned, that President Trump is introducing some very notable ambiguity into this classification question.
sentences.zh: 好吧，让我们多谈谈你刚才提到的，特朗普总统正在这个机密问题上引入一些非常值得注意的模糊性。

sentences.en: He was in the Oval Office.
sentences.zh: 他在椭圆形办公室。

sentences.en: I just want to play what he said and have you all process it.
sentences.zh: 我只想播放他说的话，让你们大家分析一下。

sentences.en: Do you still believe nothing classified was shared?
sentences.zh: 你仍然认为没有分享任何机密信息吗？

sentences.en: Well, that's what I've heard.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我是这么听说的。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: I'm not sure.
sentences.zh: 我不确定。

sentences.en: You'll have to ask the various people involved.
sentences.zh: 你得去问问相关人员。

sentences.en: I really don't know.
sentences.zh: 我真的不知道。

sentences.en: That does not sound to my ears like somebody backing up the claims of two very important deputies before Congress, right?
sentences.zh: 在我听来，这听起来不像是一个人在支持他在国会前两位非常重要的副手的主张，对吧？

sentences.en: It's impossible to say whether Trump actually knows that it's classified, whether he's been told that it may have been classified at one point, or whether he's just trying
sentences.zh: 很难说特朗普是否真的知道这是机密，是否有人告诉过他这在某个时候可能是机密，或者他只是想

sentences.en: to move on from the question.
sentences.zh: 从这个问题中脱身。

sentences.en: You're talking about somebody who likes to act surprised when he hears something, even if he knew it already in public.
sentences.zh: 你谈论的是一个喜欢在听到某事时表现出惊讶的人，即使他在公开场合已经知道了。

sentences.en: What he wants to do is move on from this as fast as possible and not get tangled up in a question from a reporter.
sentences.zh: 他想做的是尽快摆脱这件事，不要被记者的提问缠住。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: Of course, at the heart of this classification debate is the question of just how dangerous the information in these texts really is to soldiers.
sentences.zh: 当然，这场机密辩论的核心问题是，这些短信中的信息对士兵来说到底有多危险。

sentences.en: And we've started to think about that in this conversation, but I want to get into real detail about it because it seems so important.
sentences.zh: 我们已经在谈话中开始思考这个问题了，但我希望能深入探讨细节，因为它看起来非常重要。

sentences.en: And I wonder if we can even imagine,
sentences.zh: 我想知道我们是否能想象，

sentences.en: Eric or Julian, because you've covered this really closely over the past few days, the scenarios in which this information becomes a danger to U.S.
sentences.zh: 埃里克或朱利安，因为你们过去几天一直在密切关注此事，这些信息对即将执行也门袭击任务的美国

sentences.en: soldiers who were about to carry out this attack in Yemen.
sentences.zh: 士兵构成危险的情景。

sentences.en: I feel like it would really help listeners if we could get specific about the idea of how this might be dangerous.
sentences.zh: 我觉得如果我们能具体说明这可能如何构成危险，会对听众很有帮助。

sentences.en: Okay, so let me give you one example.
sentences.zh: 好的，让我给你们举个例子。

sentences.en: Two hours before this attack takes place,
sentences.zh: 在袭击发生前两个小时，

sentences.en: Pete Hankseth alerts this group that this is going to happen.
sentences.zh: 皮特·海格塞斯提醒这个小组这件事即将发生。

sentences.en: The first group of F-18 Super Hornets off the aircraft carrier Harry S.
sentences.zh: 第一批从哈里·S·杜鲁门号航空母舰上起飞的F-18超级大黄蜂战机，

sentences.en: Truman, which is in the Red Sea, these are about to take off.
sentences.zh: 该航母位于红海，它们即将起飞。

sentences.en: He's basically saying to anybody who might get a hold of this information, you have two hours to adjust your defenses on the ground if you're the Houthis.
sentences.zh: 他基本上是在告诉任何可能获取这些信息的人，如果你是胡塞武装，你有两个小时的时间来调整地面防御。

sentences.en: And so this gives them advanced warning to prepare to go after these planes in a much more aggressive way than they might be able to.
sentences.zh: 这给了他们提前预警，让他们能以比平时更具侵略性的方式准备应对这些飞机。

sentences.en: Even though the techs don't specify targets and precise locations of where U.S.
sentences.zh: 尽管短信没有具体说明目标和美国

sentences.en: planes are going to be.
sentences.zh: 飞机将要到达的精确位置。

sentences.en: But they have the launch times, and they know in general where the planes and drones are launching from, and that's all they would need to know to position their air defenses
sentences.zh: 但他们掌握了起飞时间，并且大致知道飞机和无人机从哪里起飞，而这就是他们调整防空系统

sentences.en: to be ready.
sentences.zh: 做好准备所需知道的一切。

sentences.en: Now, there's no evidence that the Houthis can penetrate phones.
sentences.zh: 目前没有证据表明胡塞武装能够入侵手机。

sentences.en: They don't have that technology as far as we know.
sentences.zh: 据我们所知，他们没有那种技术。

sentences.en: But we know the Chinese have broadly hacked
sentences.zh: 但我们知道中国人已经广泛入侵了

sentences.en: American mobile networks.
sentences.zh: 美国的移动网络。

sentences.en: That's one reason everybody moved to Signal.
sentences.zh: 这就是每个人都转向使用Signal的一个原因。

sentences.en: We do know if a nation state hacks your phone, your Signal would not be as secure if your phone had not been hacked.
sentences.zh: 我们确实知道，如果一个国家行为体入侵了你的手机，那么如果你的手机没被入侵，你的Signal就不会那么不安全。

sentences.en: So the danger you're suggesting is perhaps China had been already living inside the phone of one of the 20 participants on this text thread.
sentences.zh: 所以你暗示的危险是，也许中国已经潜伏在这个短信群组的20名参与者之一的手机里了。

sentences.en: Well, J.D.
sentences.zh: 嗯，J.D.

sentences.en: Vance was among the targets of the China hack.
sentences.zh: 万斯就是中国黑客攻击的目标之一。

sentences.en: So just for starters.
sentences.zh: 所以这只是个开始。

sentences.en: They got J.D.
sentences.zh: 他们拿到了J.D.

sentences.en: Vance's phone, right?
sentences.zh: 万斯的手机，对吧？

sentences.en: They were on it.
sentences.zh: 他们就在里面。

sentences.en: They were listening to J.D.
sentences.zh: 他们当时正在监听 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance's conversations.
sentences.zh: 万斯的谈话。

sentences.en: And the other data point is the Russians have provided intelligence to the Houthis before.
sentences.zh: 另一个数据点是，俄罗斯人以前曾向胡塞武装提供过情报。

sentences.en: It's not a theoretical problem.
sentences.zh: 这不是一个理论上的问题。

sentences.en: Now, it hasn't been a massive amount, but it's been enough that the Biden administration was worried about this.
sentences.zh: 虽然数量不算巨大，但已经足以让拜登政府感到担忧了。

sentences.en: It is a pathway where the Russians, in order to tweak the United States, have given Houthis information that they can act on.
sentences.zh: 这是一个俄罗斯人为了戏弄美国，向胡塞武装提供他们可以据此采取行动的信息的途径。
